createProduct.description: Creates a unit with sensible defaults. Your subscription is updated automatically.

inviteMember.description: Invites someone to your organization with the user role. They receive an email with a link to accept the invitation. Make members admin or superuser in the dashboard.

revokeMember.description: Removes a member with the user role from your organization. Revoke admins and superusers in the dashboard.
